hints.title: Row-based Exam Ordering
hints.text: Each row represents a student, and column k represents their score in the kth exam.

hints.title: Sorting Key Assignment
hints.text: Sort the rows of the matrix in descending order using the value at column k as the primary key.

hints.title: In-Place or New List Sorting
hints.text: Use a custom comparator or sort key lambda to order rows by row[k] descending.

hints.title: Column Score Sorting Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting m rows based on the kth column value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Bubble sort or manual row exchange takes O(m^2 * n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard sorting key on matrix rows.
